categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet configuration and transaction resubmission logic in src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Decoupling rebroadcast from initial broadcast fixes a notable transaction-origin privacy leak where periodic announces to all connected peers reveal wallet ownership. As noted in the PR description, 'periodically send to everybody could have bad implications for privacy' and previously could not be disabled without also disabling initial broadcasts.
